decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent. Utilizing cheap interaction such as Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Spell Pierce to protect our creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Card advantage is gained through cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, while also utilizing powerful threats like Murktide Regent. The deck aims to maintain tempo and control the game with a mix of aggression and disruption, utilizing a well-balanced strategy to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. Using cards like Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands, it can create explosive turns that allow it to search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens. The key is to assemble the right combination of lands and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with huge creatures and powerful abilities, making it a formidable combo deck in the Modern format.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands like Gruul Turf to generate extra mana and put multiple Primeval Titans on the battlefield. Using Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to help fix mana and allow lands to tap for any color, the deck can search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive damage when Titans enter the battlefield. The key strategy is to ramp up quickly, find the combo pieces needed, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and land-based triggers.

The focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to dominate the game through resource manipulation, powerful destruction spells, and the ability to outvalue opponents with card advantage and potent threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. With a mixture of targeted discard spells, removal spells, and powerful finishers, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantages to overwhelm them in the late game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and The One Ring offer additional utility and potent threats to further solidify the deck's control strategy.

This deck focuses on cycling through your deck quickly to get your combo pieces on the battlefield. The key is to manipulate your graveyard by cycling cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to eventually cast Living End, which will bring all your creatures back onto the battlefield, often overwhelming your opponent. Cards like Grief and Force of Negation help disrupt your opponent's game plan while Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves provide additional value. Overall, the deck aims to quickly set up its combo and outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive play, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly pressure opponents. It also utilizes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to control the opponent's hand and strategy. The deck includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to deal with threats efficiently. Additionally, it has synergies between cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to disrupt the opponent's graveyard and game plan. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through various counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects. The key strategy revolves around using The One Ring, which can generate card advantage and manipulate the opponent's resources. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the pace of the game. By managing the opponent's threats and maximizing its own resources, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver its opponent until it can secure a win condition.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient creature spells and burn spells, maintaining card advantage with cantrips and Mishra's Bauble, while also utilizing the graveyard with Underworld Breach for added recursion and reach. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan with targeted removal, and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and allows for a consistent aggressive game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. Key cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief put pressure on the opponent while Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker disrupt their game plan. Molten Collapse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional damage and card advantage. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with opposing threats. The goal is to establish an early board presence and apply constant pressure to force the opponent into a defensive position.

The deck focuses on maximizing early game aggression through the use of efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, as well as direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Rift Bolt, Lava Spike, and Skewer the Critics. It also utilizes cards like Searing Blaze and Boros Charm to control the board and protect its creatures. The mana base is optimized for consistent early game aggression with a mix of fetch lands, shock lands, and pain lands. Additionally, it includes Skullcrack and Eidolon of the Great Revel to disrupt opponent's strategies and prevent them from stabilizing.

This deck focuses on using a variety of creatures to tutor for specific cards and create powerful combos on the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck can quickly assemble a potent board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The creatures in the deck serve as a toolbox, allowing for flexibility in responding to different situations and adapting to various strategies. With a mix of ramp, recursion, and disruption, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through strategic plays and synergistic interactions.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while using efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the board. Counterspells are used to protect key creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Murktide Regent and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent casting of spells, and options like Spell Pierce and Spell Snare provide additional disruption against opposing spells.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent with hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief to pressure the opponent's life total. The deck packs removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with threats and maintain board control. Additionally, the deck includes important lands like Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's mana base and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for a powerful end-game threat. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt opponent's strategy, and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of creatures, spells, and lands to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The key strategy is to put pressure on the opponent early in the game, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Wild Nacatl to deal damage while also controlling the board with Leyline of the Guildpact and Stubborn Denial. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and resources. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault, ultimately securing victory through fast and decisive plays.

This deck revolves around the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and the Titan creatures, allowing for explosive ramp and powerful land interactions. By utilizing cards like Explore and Arboreal Grazer, the player can quickly assemble the necessary lands to play Primeval Titan and search for key utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens. With the ability to generate a lot of mana and play multiple lands per turn, the player can overwhelm their opponent with big creatures and versatile land abilities.

This deck focuses on maximizing the number of +1/+1 counters placed on creatures and artifacts to create a powerful board presence quickly. Cards like Hardened Scales and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp help to increase the effectiveness of these counters, while Walking Ballista and Arcbound Ravager can benefit greatly from them. The deck also includes utility cards like Urza's Saga and Pendelhaven to further enhance the strategy. Aggro creatures like Hangarback Walker and Patchwork Automaton provide additional threats, making this deck a fast and aggressive force to be reckoned with.
